title: Operation serves Applicationfunction
description: An API operation serves an application function that is its client: the function calls the operation, typically another service's endpoint over HTTP. Use `api.operation realizes application.applicationfunction` instead when the function is the behavior behind the operation, the code that handles it.
x-dr-evidence: The function's body sends an HTTP request to the operation's method and route, directly or through an HTTP client or generated SDK call, and does not handle that route itself; CBM HTTP_CALLS from the function, or CROSS_HTTP_CALLS when the operation is in another repository's model.
